work_orders.objective:
Assumptions
- Open public access with no mandatory user authentication or sign-up friction.
- Analysis performed via structured LLM prompt pipelines returning strict JSON for UI rendering.
- Server-side API key management and per-IP rate limiting to prevent quota exhaustion and abuse.
- Responsive, modern web stack (Next.js / Tailwind CSS) deployable to standard remote serverless runtimes.
Core Capabilities
- Instant Text Analysis Pipeline
  - Input accepting raw text up to 5,000 words with auto-trimming and sample preset prompts.
  - Multi-dimensional scoring: Overall BS Index (0-100%), Fact-to-Fluff Ratio, Fallacy Density, and Rhetorical Risk level.
  - Granular claim extraction: highlights specific sentences/phrases flagged for unsupported claims, jargon soup, weasel words, or logical leaps.
  - Witty Executive Verdict: generates a punchy, humorous summary diagnosis.
- Interactive Teardown & Highlighting
  - Interactive text viewer highlighting flagged sections in color-coded badges (e.g., 'Pure Fiction', 'Weasel Words', 'Source: Trust Me Bro', 'Buzzword Overdose').
  - Click-to-inspect popovers explaining why a flagged phrase failed inspection with snarky but actionable breakdowns.
- Sharing & Export
  - One-click scorecard generator creating a downloadable / copyable social card graphic with key metrics and verdict.
  - Shareable report URL generated from persistent lightweight report hashes.
Data
- Stateless analysis by default; optional persistent storage (e.g., PostgreSQL or Redis KV) for public shareable report slugs and rate-limiting counters.
Deliverables
- Next.js App Router frontend and API route architecture with Tailwind CSS UI components.
- Robust analysis engine module with prompt templates, JSON schema validation, and fallback handlers.
- Dynamic scorecard export engine.
- Comprehensive README and environment configuration template.
Integrations
- OpenAI / Anthropic API for structured JSON reasoning and claim decomposition.
- OG Image generation library (@vercel/og or Satori) for dynamic preview cards.
Objective
- Deliver an instantly usable single-page application where users paste any text (press releases, sales pitches, social posts, articles) and receive an engaging, color-coded 'Bullshit Audit' with a 0-100% BS score, categorized claim teardowns, and humorous commentary.
Project
- IS THIS BULLSHIT? — A comedic yet analytically sharp web application that evaluates text for unsubstantiated claims, logical fallacies, jargon-dense fluff, and deceptive rhetoric.
Safety & Constraints
- Per-IP rate limiting and max character caps to control LLM token costs.
- Content safety filters to reject explicit hate speech while preserving freedom to analyze sensitive or political rhetoric.
- Clear disclaimer indicating the tool is satirical and for entertainment / rhetorical evaluation purposes.
User Experience
- Loud, polished, brutalist-meets-modern UI with clean typography, snappy micro-interactions, and sound/visual punchiness.
- Immediate sample presets ('Corporate Layoff Memo', 'LinkedIn Influencer Hustle', 'Crypto Whitepaper Abstract') for zero-click instant testing.
- Real-time animated analysis progress state with comedic scanning statuses (e.g., 'Calibrating skepticism...', 'Checking for missing citations...').
